Kitchen Remodeling in Eastborough, KS

Eastborough is Wichita's premium residential enclave - a small, independent municipality completely surrounded by east Wichita, with custom homes from the 1940s through the 1990s on mature, well-established lots along Woodward Avenue, Crestway Drive

Eastborough's approximately 800 residents represent one of the highest median household income levels in the Wichita metro - these are properties that have held value because they were built right and maintained well., and the quiet residential streets east of Rock Road. The kitchens in Eastborough homes are as varied as the homes themselves, but they share one characteristic: they deserve a contractor who understands the difference between a custom home remodel and a production housing refresh.

A kitchen remodel in Eastborough isn't a cabinet swap and a countertop upgrade. It's an opportunity to restore or elevate a home that was built with craftsmanship - and a project that goes badly shows in a way that it wouldn't in a tract subdivision. The quality of the work, the fit of the custom cabinetry, the material selections, and the attention to architectural detail all matter more in these homes than in production builds.

Wheatland Construction works at this level. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018. We understand what Eastborough kitchens require and we deliver it.

What Eastborough Kitchen Remodels Look Like

Mid-century custom homes (1950s-1970s): Many of these kitchens have had partial updates over the decades - some good, some less so. The work often involves rationalizing what was added across multiple owners and bringing the kitchen to a coherent, high-quality finish. Custom cabinetry, stone countertops, proper exterior-vented ventilation, and architectural details that match the home's original character.

Late-century custom homes (1980s-1990s): These may have been done in period-appropriate finishes - lots of oak, laminate countertops that were premium at the time - that are now dated but structurally sound. The scope here is often a material upgrade that respects the home's layout and bones while bringing the finishes current.

Full gut renovations: When the kitchen has been extensively modified over decades and doesn't work well anymore, sometimes the right answer is to start over. We do this at a level appropriate for Eastborough homes - custom or semi-custom cabinets, natural stone or quartz, proper ventilation, integrated appliance panels, concealed lighting, architectural millwork.

Finish Level We Work At in Eastborough

  • Custom and semi-custom cabinetry - not stock builder cabinets; door styles and finishes selected to complement the home's architectural character
  • Natural stone - marble, granite, quartzite for countertops and backsplash where appropriate; quartz where durability is the priority
  • Integrated appliance panels - refrigerator and dishwasher panels to match cabinetry
  • Architectural millwork - corbels, pilasters, crown molding details, range hood surrounds built to match the home
  • Professional-grade appliances - coordination with appliance supplier of your choice; we rough-in and install

Permits in Eastborough

Eastborough is an independent municipality with its own building permit process - separate from Wichita. We work with Eastborough's permit requirements regularly and handle all applications, fees, and inspection scheduling.

How We Approach Kitchen Remodeling in Eastborough

Every kitchen remodel starts with a site visit. We measure the existing layout, look at the plumbing rough-in and drain stack location, check the electrical panel for capacity, and assess structural walls before discussing what's possible. We price in writing with every line item documented.

Our crew handles demo through final walkthrough. Cabinet delivery, tile setting, countertop templating, plumbing trim-out, electrical, and final inspection all coordinated through us - no handoffs to subcontractors who don't know the project.

Wheatland Construction has held Veterans Approved Builder status (ID: 00899) since we opened and has been Home Advisor Certified since 2019. We're licensed and insured in Kansas.

In Eastborough, independent municipality status means its own permit process separate from Wichita. We work with Eastborough's building department specifically.

Frequently Asked Questions About Kitchen Remodeling in Eastborough

How much does kitchen remodeling cost in Eastborough, KS?

Eastborough kitchen remodels typically start at $45,000 and range to $150,000+ for full custom gut renovations with high-end cabinetry, natural stone, and professional-grade appliances. We provide detailed written estimates with complete scope documentation.

Does Eastborough have its own building permit process?

Yes - Eastborough is an independent municipality with its own building department, separate from Wichita. We handle Eastborough permits specifically.

What level of cabinetry do you use in Eastborough kitchens?

Custom and semi-custom, sourced from manufacturers we've vetted for quality. Stock builder-grade cabinets don't belong in Eastborough homes and we don't use them. We discuss manufacturer options and door styles at the consultation.

Can you match the existing architectural character of an older Eastborough home?

Yes - this is a priority in custom home remodeling. We assess the home's architectural language and execute details (millwork profiles, panel proportions, material selections) that integrate with the existing character rather than impose a trend.

How long does an Eastborough kitchen remodel take?

12-20 weeks for full custom gut renovations, depending on custom cabinet lead times and material delivery. We build a detailed schedule and communicate throughout.
